_comment: Copy to devices.json and edit. bind to a PRIVATE interface only (localhost or your VPN/tailnet IP) and SET a token — these endpoints are full device control. devices.json is yours; never commit it. You can also configure most of this from the console UI (⚙ Options → Open server settings).
_processor_comment: Which Acurast processor this console manages. Leave blank for the canary default.
_command_channel_comment: Signed readb/locate channel. Set the SAME value here and in the app (ENABLE_PROTECTION --es command_secret <same>). Blank = channel off. Also flip READB_ENABLED in fleet.py after your own operator-present test.
